material_type.evidence: Plasma proteins are considered to be the most informative source of biomarkers for disease diagnosis and monitoring.

sample_source.evidence: In brief, we retrospectively obtained blood samples from newly diagnosed HCC patients who visited Nanfang Hospital between July 2021 and August 2022 (all stages, with BCLC A stage as early-stage and the others as intermediate and advanced-stage).

Healthy volunteers who were not diagnosed with any form of cancer or liver-related disease, such as hepatitis or cirrhosis, at the time of blood collection were recruited between June 2022 and October 2022.

sex.evidence: A total of 56 age- and sex-matched subjects were randomly selected from both the HCC patient and healthy groups for analysis, and no significant differences were observed between the two groups based on Wilcoxon or Fisher tests.
